slides.title: Formula Quick Reference
text: Coterminal: θ ± 360° (or ± 2π) | Arc length: s = rθ (θ in radians) | Convert: deg × π/180 = rad
sin = opp/hyp | cos = adj/hyp | tan = opp/adj | Inverse: θ = sin⁻¹(ratio)
Q I: θ' = θ | Q II: 180° − θ | Q III: θ − 180° | Q IV: 360° − θ
Q I: All + | Q II: Sin + | Q III: Tan + | Q IV: Cos +
sin θ = y/r | cos θ = x/r | tan θ = y/x | r = √(x²+y²)
A = ½bc sin A (two sides + included angle, works for ANY triangle)
v = ⟨x₂−x₁, y₂−y₁⟩ | |v| = √(a²+b²) | θ = tan⁻¹(b/a) + quadrant adj.
